desc: International eats & cocktails served in an airy, trendy gathering place with live music & DJ sets.
addr: Ground Floor 1st Main Road 23, Ganapathi Temple Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: Visited on a Tuesday for wings ofcourse. Service is quick and the place is decent with good music. The wings are good as always from planB. Few items from the menu are not available but it's okay. Mocktails are excellent. B company is must try! On overall a satisfactory experience.
Food was good, and the service time was late and they don't serve food, in total service wasn't good, but except that food and ambiance are good here. …
